rv.q: Sadly, the five-star production values are wrapped around a barely two-star adaptation of the novel itself.

And this show, which is running through May 31 at the Benedum Center in Downtown Pittsburgh as part of the Pittsburgh Cultural Trust's PNC Broadway in Pittsburgh Series, has glimmers of fun and heart.

cn.t: Dazzling production values and Tony-winning costumes can't compensate for a lackluster adaptation that prioritizes style over substance, resulting in an entertaining but ultimately hollow take on Fitzgerald's classic.
